scripts.start: concurrently -k -n web,bridge -c cyan,magenta "next start" "./scripts/with-secrets.sh tsx src/server/bridge-server.ts"
scripts.secrets:set: read -s -p 'OPENAI_API_KEY: ' K && security add-generic-password -a "$USER" -s uranus-openai-key -U -w "$K" && unset K && echo && echo stored
scripts.secrets:show-status: security find-generic-password -a $USER -s uranus-openai-key -w >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo 'keychain: uranus-openai-key present' || echo 'keychain: not set (run npm run secrets:set)'
